en: How can I take the BukSU College Admission Test?
Follow these steps to apply for the BukSU College Admission Test:
Step 1: Access http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph. Register using your active Gmail account. Create your password and re-type it for verification.
Step 2: After creating an account, an email containing a confirmation link will be sent to your Gmail. Check your inbox and click the link to activate your account.
Step 3: Fill out all the necessary information and upload the documentary requirements.
Step 4: Select your preferred schedule (venue, date, and time) based on the availability of slots.
Step 5: You will get notifications when your application is accepted. Once accepted, download and print your Test Permit.
ceb: Unsaon nako pagkuha sa BukSU College Admission Test?
Sunod kining mga lakang aron mag-apply sa BukSU College Admission Test:
Step 1: Bisitaha ang http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph. Mag-register gamit ang imong active nga Gmail account. Himoa ang imong password ug i-type pag-usab para sa verification.
Step 2: Human makahimo og account, usa ka email nga adunay confirmation link ipadala sa imong Gmail. Tan-awa ang imong inbox ug i-klik ang link aron ma-activate ang imong account.
Step 3: Pun-a ang tanan nga kinahanglan nga impormasyon ug i-upload ang mga documentary requirements.
Step 4: Pilia ang imong preferred schedule (venue, petsa, ug oras) base sa available nga slots.
Step 5: Makadawat ka og notifications kung gi-accept ang imong aplikasyon. Kung ma-accept, i-download ug i-print ang imong Test Permit.

en: What should I do if there is an error in my name on the test permit?
If there is an error in the name or personal information on your BukSU CAT test permit, you should:
1. Log in to your BukSU Admission account at http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
2. Go to your application profile and check the personal information you submitted.
3. If the name on your application form is also incorrect, edit and correct it, then save the changes.
4. Re-download your test permit after saving the corrections.
5. If you are unable to edit your information or the error remains, contact or visit the BukSU Admission and Testing Unit (ATU) as soon as possible — ideally before your exam schedule.
Note: Bring both your corrected test permit and a valid government-issued ID on the day of the exam to avoid issues at the testing venue.
ceb: Unsa ang buhaton kung naay sayup sa akong ngalan sa test permit?
Kung naay sayup sa ngalan o personal information sa imong BukSU CAT test permit, buhata ang mosunod:
1. Log in sa imong BukSU Admission account sa http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
2. Adtoa ang imong application profile ug susihon ang imong personal information nga gi-submit nimo.
3. Kung ang ngalan sa imong application form sayup usab, i-edit ug i-correct kini, unya i-save ang mga pagbabago.
4. I-download usab ang imong test permit human sa pagkorrekto.
5. Kung dili ka maka-edit sa imong information o nagpabilin ang sayup, kontaka o adtoa ang BukSU Admission and Testing Unit (ATU) sa labing madali — mas maayo sa wala pa ang imong exam schedule.
Hinumdomi: Dad-a ang imong corrected test permit ug valid government-issued ID sa adlaw sa exam aron malikayan ang problema sa testing venue.

en: How to confirm the Intent to Enroll in the BukSU admission portal after passing the CAT?
After the CAT results are released and you have passed:
Step 1: Log in to your BukSU Admission account at http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph using your registered Gmail.
Step 2: Look for the 'Intent to Enroll' or 'Confirm Enrollment' button/option in your dashboard. This option usually appears after the official release of results.
Step 3: Select and confirm your Intent to Enroll. Make sure to do this within the deadline set by the BukSU Admission and Testing Unit.
Step 4: After confirming, take note of or print the acknowledgment for your records.
Note: Failing to confirm your Intent to Enroll within the given deadline may forfeit your slot. For the exact deadline and steps, check the BukSU ATU Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/BukSUATU
ceb: Unsaon pag-confirm sa Intent to Enroll sa BukSU admission portal human sa CAT?

Hakbang 2: Pangitaa ang 'Intent to Enroll' o 'Confirm Enrollment' nga button/option sa imong dashboard. Kini nga option kasagarang makita human ma-officially release ang results.
Hakbang 3: Pilia ug i-confirm ang imong Intent to Enroll. Siguroa nga buhaton nimo kini sa sulod sa deadline nga gitakda sa BukSU Admission and Testing Unit.
Hakbang 4: Human sa pagkumpirma, hinumdomi o i-print ang acknowledgment para sa imong records.

Hinumdomi: Kung dili nimo ma-confirm ang Intent to Enroll sulod sa deadline, mahimong mawagtang ang imong slot. Para sa eksaktong deadline ug mga lakang, tan-awa ang BukSU ATU Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/BukSUATU

en: Can I apply as a walk-in for the BukSU CAT, or is it strictly online?
Application and slot registration for the BukSU College Admission Test (CAT) is strictly conducted ONLINE through the official admission website: http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph.
Walk-in applications for exam scheduling are not accommodated because testing slots, venues, and test permits are managed through the online system.

However, the actual examination is conducted in-person (face-to-face) at your selected testing venue and schedule. Be sure to register online, secure your test permit, and bring the required documents on exam day.
ceb: Pwede ba mag-walk-in application sa BukSU CAT o strictly online lang?
Ang pag-apply ug pag-schedule sa BukSU College Admission Test (CAT) kay strictly ONLINE lamang pinaagi sa opisyal nga admission portal: http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph.
Dili gidawat ang walk-in nga pag-apply para sa exam schedule tungod kay ang mga slots, testing venues, ug test permits gi-manage pinaagi sa online system.

Apan, ang aktuwal nga examination kay in-person (face-to-face) nga kuhaon sa imong napili nga testing center ug schedule. Siguroha nga maka-register ka online, ma-download ang test permit, ug dad-on ang mga kinahanglanon sa adlaw sa exam.

en: Are there fees for the College Admission Test?
The BukSU College Admission Test **(BukSU-CAT) is FREE for all Grade 12 students and SHS graduates who have not yet enrolled in college.**
However, applicants who have already completed a bachelors degree or at least enrolled college in BukSU need to pay 300 Php for the Admission Test.
They are not qualified to avail of the benefits of the Free Higher Education.

🔔 REMINDERS
**No onsite applications** will be accepted on the test day. Only those with approved schedules can take the test.
**You can only take the BukSU-CAT once every school year.**
**DO NOT CREATE MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS**
ceb: Naay bayad ang College Admission Test?
Ang College Admission Test kay libre ra para sa mga Grade 12 students ug SHS graduates nga wala pa maka-enroll sa kolehiyo.
Apan, ang mga aplikante nga nakakompleto na og bachelor's degree o at least naka-enroll na sa kolehiyo sa BukSU kinahanglan magbayad og 300 Php para sa Admission Test.
Dili sila kwalipikado sa mga benepisyo sa Free Higher Education.

🔔PAHINUMDOM
**DILI MODWAT OG ONSITE APPLICATIONS** sa test day. Ang mga may approval schedules lamang ang pwede mo-take sa exam.
**Pwede ra kuhaan og usa ka higayon lang ang BukSU-CAT matag tuig.**
**AYAW PagHimo OG DAGHANG ACCOUNTS**

en: How long does it take for BukSU admission applications to be approved?
Admission Officers evaluate and verify applications during regular university working hours (Mondays to Fridays, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, excluding weekends and university holidays).
The standard evaluation and approval process typically takes **3 to 5 working days** after submitting your complete online application and documentary requirements.
You will receive an email notification and a status update on your https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph dashboard once your application is approved.
*(Note: Incomplete, blurred, or non-compliant documents may cause delays in approval or application denial)*

Ang standard nga evaluation ug pag-apruba kasagarang molungtad og **3 hangtod 5 ka working days** human nimo ma-submit ang kompleto nga online application ug documentary requirements.
Makadawat ka og email notification ug status update sa imong https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph dashboard kung ma-aprubahan na ang imong aplikasyon.

en: Why was my BukSU admission application denied or rejected?
The most common reasons for admission application denial include:

1. **2x2 Profile Picture Specification**: The photo does not have a pure white background, is not wearing a plain white T-shirt, contains accessories (caps, earrings, sunglasses, headbands), or is distorted/blurry.
2. **Account Details Discrepancy**: Your full name, contact number, or Gmail address does not match your official school records.
3. **Documentary & Signature Issues**: The Principal's Certification lacks the official signature or school seal of your Principal, or the scan of your Report Card (Form 138) is unreadable.

**How to Fix:** Log in to https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph, edit your application, replace the flagged photo or document, and re-submit. If your application continues to be denied, visit the Admission Office on the CPAG Building ground floor for assistance.
ceb: Nganong na-deny o na-reject ang akong BukSU admission application?
Ang kasagarang mga hinungdan ngano ma-deny ang application mao ang mosunod:
1. **2x2 Profile Picture Specification**: Ang litrato walay puti nga background, wala nagsul-ob og plain puti nga T-shirt, adunay accessories (kalo, ariyos, sunglasses), o hanap ang file.
2. **Sayop nga Account Details**: Ang imong ngalan, contact number, o Gmail dili parehas sa imong opisyal nga records.
3. **Kulang o Walay Pirma nga Dokumento**: Ang Principal's Certification walay pirma o dry seal sa inyong principal, o dili klaro ang scan sa Report Card (Form 138).

**Unsaon Pag-ayo:** Pag-log in sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph, i-edit ang imong application, ilisi ang sayop nga litrato o dokumento, ug i-submit pag-usab. Kung ma-deny gihapon, bisitaha ang Admission Office sa CPAG Building ground floor.

en: Here are the requirements you need before applying for BukSU Admission Testing:
1. You need to have your own personal Gmail account to create an account on BukSU Admissions: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/

2. You need a digital copy of your 2x2 photo. Please make sure your photo meets the following **specifications: plain white background, wearing a white T-shirt, no accessories, and the correct 2x2 size.**
For documentary requirements:
**For current Grade 12 students:** A certification from your school principal that you are currently enrolled in Grade 12
**For SHS graduates:** Copy of your Report Card or High School Diploma
**For Transferees:** Transcript of Records or Honorable Dismissal, or a certification from your current school’s Registrar
**For Returnees** (stopped studying in BukSU before 2018): Request a certification from the Registrar through this link: https://forms.gle/aKoX7zTJmnTSBNNFA
**For Second Courser:** Transcript of Records. (If it has been more than five years since your last school attendance, you must take the College Admission Test and pay 300 testing fee)
After applying for BukSU Admission, please wait for approval.
Note: Your Gmail should be accessible, as all verification codes will be sent there.
ceb: Kini ang mga requirements nga imong gikinahanglan sa dili pa mag-apply para sa BukSU Admission Testing:
1. Kinahanglan nga aduna kay kaugalingong personal nga Gmail account aron makahimo og account sa BukSU Admissions: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/

2. Kinahanglan nimo og digital copy sa imong 2x2 picture. Palihug siguroha nga ang imong litrato mosubay sa mosunod nga **mga detalye: plain white background, nagsul-ob og puti nga T-shirt, walay accessories, ug sakto nga 2x2 nga gidak-on.**
Para sa documentary requirements:
**Para sa mga kasamtangang Grade 12 nga estudyante:** Sertipikasyon gikan sa inyong principal nga ikaw kasamtangang na-enroll sa Grade 12
**Para sa mga SHS graduates:** Kopya sa imong Report Card o High School Diploma
**Para sa mga Transferee:** Transcript of Records o Honorable Dismissal, o sertipikasyon gikan sa Registrar sa imong kasamtangang eskwelahan
**Para sa mga Returnee** (niundang og eskwela sa BukSU sa wala pa ang 2018): Pangayo og sertipikasyon gikan sa Registrar pinaagi niini nga link: https://forms.gle/aKoX7zTJmnTSBNNFA

**Para sa mga Second Courser:** Transcript of Records. (Kung sobra na sa lima ka tuig sukad sa imong kataposang pag-eskwela, kinahanglan kang mokuha sa College Admission Test ug magbayad og 300 nga testing fee)
Human makapa-rehistro sa BukSU Admission, palihug paghulat sa pag-apruba.
Pahinumdom: Siguroha nga ma-access nimo ang imong Gmail, tungod kay ang tanang verification code ipadala didto.

en: If you failed your BukSU cat examination you still have a choice, you can apply for Affirmative Action Program (AAP) but please note that you cannot choose the courses you want to enroll in, they will be the one choosing your program depends on your capability.
here how you can apply the AAP

1. Monitor Your Results: Check your Report of Rating (ROR) via the BukSU Admissions Portal. Even if you are not on the list of Qualifiers, keep your account credentials. https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/
2 Go to the Diversity and Inclusion Unit located at the BukSU Main Campus in Malaybalay City. This unit manages the AAP selection.

3. Submit Supporting Documents: You will need to provide proof of your eligibility, such as:
For IPs: Certificate of Tribal Membership or NCIP Certificate.
For PWDs: Valid PWD ID.
For Low-Income: Certificate of Indigency from your Barangay or ITR of parents.
Academic Records: Your Senior High School Report Card (Form 138).
4. Interview/Evaluation: The Diversity and Inclusion Unit may conduct an interview to assess your academic potential and commitment to finishing the degree.

5. Placement: If approved, you may be offered a slot in a program that still has available capacity (note that highly competitive board courses like Nursing or Accountancy often have stricter cut-offs that AAP cannot always bypass).
ceb: Kung wala ka nakapasar sa BukSU CAT examination, naa gihapon kay laing kapilian—pwede ka mo-apply sa Affirmative Action Program (AAP), apan palihug hinumdumi nga dili ikaw ang mopili sa kurso nga imong enrollan, sila ang mopili base sa imong kapasidad.
Ania kung giunsa pag-apply sa AAP:

1. Bantayi ang imong Resulta: Tan-awa ang imong Report of Rating (ROR) pinaagi sa BukSU Admissions Portal. Bisan dili ka apil sa listahan sa Qualifiers, i-keep ang imong account credentials. https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/
2. Adto sa Diversity and Inclusion Unit nga nahimutang sa BukSU Main Campus sa Malaybalay City. Kini nga unit ang nagdumala sa AAP selection.

3. I-submit ang Supporting Documents: Kinahanglan nimo ipakita ang pruweba sa imong eligibility, sama sa:
Para sa IPs: Certificate of Tribal Membership o NCIP Certificate.
Para sa PWDs: Valid PWD ID.
Para sa Low-Income: Certificate of Indigency gikan sa inyong Barangay o ITR sa ginikanan.
Academic Records: Senior High School Report Card (Form 138).
4. Interview/Evaluation: Ang Diversity and Inclusion Unit mahimong mag-conduct og interview aron masusi ang imong academic potential ug commitment sa paghuman sa degree.

5. Placement: Kung ma-aprubahan, mahimo kang hatagan og slot sa usa ka programa nga naa pay available nga kapasidad (hinumdumi nga ang highly competitive nga board courses sama sa Nursing o Accountancy kasagaran adunay mas istrikto nga cut-offs nga dili permi malabwan sa AAP).

en: Here is the readmission and enrollment process for Returning Students (Balik-Aral):

• **Important Policies**:
- Students who were under the **old curriculum** must re-enter the course as a first-year student.
- If it has been **more than 5 years** since your last semester of attendance, university policy dictates that you must retake the BukSU College Admission Test (BukSU-CAT) and pay a ₱300 testing fee to be reintegrated.

• **Step-by-Step Readmission Procedure**:
1. Register online at: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
2. Activate your account via email (click the activation link).
3. Update your Account Information.
4. Click 'Proceed to Account Migration' and use your previous student number to migrate your account.
5. Apply for Enrollment.
6. Steps 1–5: Complete all required information.
7. Step 6: Verify, sign, and confirm your Enrollment Application.
8. Submit and wait for your Evaluator to process your Enrollment Application.
9. Retrieve and review your Certificate of Registration (COR).
For the complete official guide, visit: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/posts/12/
ceb: Ania ang proseso sa readmission ug enrollment alang sa mga Returning Students (Balik-Aral):

• **Importanteng mga Polisiya**:
- Ang mga estudyante nga naa ubos sa **daan nga curriculum (old curriculum)** kinahanglan mosulod pag-usab isip first year student.
- Kung nilabay na og **sobra 5 ka tuig** sukad sa imong kataposang semestre sa pag-eskwela, gikinahanglan sumala sa polisiya nga mokuha ka pag-usab sa BukSU College Admission Test (BukSU-CAT) ug mobayad og ₱300 testing fee aron ma-reintegrate.

• **Step-by-Step Readmission Procedure**:
1. Pag-register online sa: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
2. I-activate ang imong account pinaagi sa email (i-click ang activation link).
3. I-update ang imong Account Information.
4. I-click ang 'Proceed to Account Migration' gamit ang imong student number aron ma-migrate ang imong account.
5. Pag-apply para sa Enrollment.
6. Kompletoha ang tanang gikinahanglang impormasyon (Steps 1–5 sa portal).
7. Step 6: I-verify, pirmahi, ug kumpirmaha ang imong Enrollment Application.
8. I-submit ug hulata ang Evaluator nga moproseso sa imong Enrollment Application.
9. Kuhaa ug susiha ang imong Certificate of Registration (COR).
Para sa opisyal nga giya sa readmission, bisitaha ang: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/posts/12/
